finding.before: Owned Writable asynchronous _destroy callback(EPIPE) after EOF/exit made close return exited:true, then process crashed with unhandled error, exit1.
finding.resolution: Handle all owned stream/readline transport errors; retain stream error guards until actual close. For unconfirmed child exit, retain its error guard until later close.

compatibility: Existing close result, stable failure, idempotence, RPC30s deadline and no-automatic-retry semantics unchanged. Confirmed closed streams remove guards; unconfirmed-child regression explicitly expects temporary guard instead of unsafe zero-listener cleanup.
summaryJa: 非同期pipe errorによる終了後crashを再現して修正。実exit未確認時の遅延child errorも保護し、成功判定は緩和しない。
summaryEn: Reproduced and fixed late pipe-error crashes. Late child errors after unconfirmed exit are guarded without weakening success criteria.
